current.summary: Provisioned the production VPS and resolved the schema-blocking open questions. Got into the Azure arm64 box, switched it to SSH-key auth, discovered its big NVMe is ephemeral and attached a 64GB Premium SSD at /data instead, then stood up Postgres 16.4+PostGIS 3.4.3, Redis, MinIO and Caddy in Docker Compose - all arm64-native, localhost-bound, reboot-surviving. Then, via the interview skill, settled ledger-account grain as one wallet per provider (corroborated by data-model 1:1 and the design canvas), reframed the other blockers as admin/policy, and wrote docs/wallet.md consolidating the wallet flow end to end.
current.state: Running arm64 data stack on the VM (no schema yet) + 30 spec docs including new wallet.md; still no product screens, no Django app
decisions: One wallet per provider, not per category - sets the ledger PK; per-category reporting rides on JOURNAL_TRANSACTION. Corroborated by data-model USER||--||LEDGER_ACCOUNT and the design canvas load-bearing decision
Most 'blockers' are admin/policy not code (user framing): verified-badge meaning is ops, code stores a status flag; dispute window/retention are config; wallet naming is label+legal, not schema
SSH key auth set up before any provisioning because the password is in the transcript
Persistent data goes on a managed Premium SSD (/data), never the 110GB NVMe which is an Azure Direct Disk = ephemeral, wiped on deallocate
Docker Compose stack, data-root and volumes on /data, everything bound to 127.0.0.1
imresamu/postgis over official postgis/postgis - the official image has no arm64 build and silently pulls amd64
working: ssh ipelege logs in by key (no password); host key pinned; secrets+.env hold creds, key path, Azure context, stack passwords
VM: Standard_D2pds_v6, Ubuntu 24.04, aarch64, 2vCPU/7.7GB, SouthAfricaNorth zone 3, passwordless sudo, 40.127.10.234
64GB Premium SSD mounted at /data by UUID (fstab, reboot-safe); docker data-root at /data/docker
Stack all healthy, arm64-native, restart:unless-stopped, docker enabled: Postgres 16.4+PostGIS 3.4.3, Redis 7 (auth), MinIO, Caddy
docs/wallet.md consolidates the wallet system; ledger-grain decision resolved and cross-linked across 6 docs + README
notWorking: No product screens, no Django backend - every Flutter route still renders PlaceholderScreen
Stack has no schema - Postgres running with PostGIS but no app tables (deliberate; waits on the booking-state blocker)
Nothing public - Postgres/Redis/MinIO localhost-only by design; Caddy has no domain and no NSG rule for 80/443
Not a durable host - 'Azure for Students' sub (~$100 cap), auto-deallocated once mid-session; real hosting quote still outstanding
47-passing-tests claim carried from prior handoff, not re-verified this session
doNotRepeat: postgis/postgis:16-3.4 on arm64 - no arm64 manifest, pulls amd64, exec format error; use imresamu/postgis
curl | sudo bash installers - blocked by auto-mode classifier; use stepwise apt-repository installs

Backgrounding az login over a one-shot SSH command (setsid/nohup &) - SSH hangs on the held channel, timeout kills it, output lost; use systemd-run --unit --collect then read the file in a separate SSH call
az login --use-device-code --only-show-errors - the flag suppresses the device-code prompt itself; drop it
Bash heredocs for large local files - use the Write tool and scp (still true from last session)

Build first real screens: consumer Home, category browse, listing detail
Add swap on the VM; decide student-sub vs local Tier III (Digital Delta DC1) quote
